**技巧一．向量极化恒等式推出的隐圆**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

**乘积型：**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

定理：平面内，若为定点，且,则的轨迹是以为圆心为半径的圆

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

证明：由，根据极化恒等式可知，，所以，的轨迹是以为圆心为半径的圆．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

**技巧二．极化恒等式和型：**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

证明：，所以，即的轨迹是以中点为圆心，为半径的圆．
